verified_facts.text: Edgewood Tahoe Resort sits on the shores of Lake Tahoe, North America's largest alpine lake, bounded by the peaks of the Sierra.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled on the shores of Lake Tahoe, North America’s largest alpine lake, and bounded by the majestic peaks of the Sierra

verified_facts.text: The resort is inspired by the rustic elegance of the great lodges of the American West.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the rustic elegance seen in the great lodges of the American West

verified_facts.text: The Lodge at Edgewood Tahoe Resort opened in 2017.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Lodge at Edgewood Tahoe Resort was unveiled to the world in 2017

verified_facts.text: The Edgewood property's history began about 150 years ago, when the Park family settled there as cattle ranchers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The storied history of the Edgewood property begins 150 years ago on the shores of Lake Tahoe, where the Park family settled as cattle ranchers.

verified_facts.text: The lakeside Edgewood course has hosted national golf tournaments, including the annual American Century Championship.
verified_facts.excerpt: this lakeside course has captured the imaginations and tested the mettle of golfers of all skill levels from around the globe, and has been home to a variety of national golf tournaments, including the annual American Century Championship

verified_facts.text: The golf course is played at an altitude of more than 6,200 feet on the shores of Lake Tahoe.
verified_facts.excerpt: playing at an altitude of more than 6,200 ft. on the shores of America’s most majestic alpine lake

verified_facts.text: Tiger Woods, Arnold Palmer, Phil Mickelson, John Daly and Lee Trevino have all played the Edgewood course.
verified_facts.excerpt: Players like Tiger Woods, Arnold Palmer, Phil Mickelson, John Daly, and Lee Trevino have all teed up here

verified_facts.text: The course hosted the 1980 USGA US Public Links Championship and the 1985 US Senior Open Championship.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1980’s USGA US Public Links Championship was held here, as was 1985’s US Senior Open Championship

verified_facts.text: The 2026 golf season ends on October 17, and the course reopens in May 2027.
verified_facts.excerpt: the 2026 golf season concludes on October 17. We hope you enjoyed your time on our award-winning course and look forward to welcoming you back in May 2027.

verified_facts.text: Spa Edgewood offers gemstone rituals that use locally sourced stones such as smoky quartz.
verified_facts.excerpt: we utilize locally-sourced stones such as Smoky Quartz, to deepen the relationship between body and earth

verified_facts.text: The spa has a signature Oxygen Bar designed for Tahoe's high altitude.
verified_facts.excerpt: our signature Oxygen Bar - designed for Tahoe's high altitude

verified_facts.text: Spa Edgewood is an adult facility for guests 18 and older.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa Edgewood is an adult facility appropriate for guests 18 and older.

verified_facts.text: Spa facility access is reserved for Lodge guests or guests with a qualifying treatment.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spa Facility Access is reserved for Lodge guests or those with a qualifying treatment.

verified_facts.text: The Villa Suites sit next to the main lodge and front the 8th and 9th fairways.
verified_facts.excerpt: Adjacent to the main lodge and fronting the 8th and 9th fairways

verified_facts.text: Villa Suites come in two-, three-, four- and five-plus-bedroom layouts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two-bedroom, three-bedroom, four-bedroom and five-plus-bedroom Villa Suites accommodate all forms of exclusive gatherings.

verified_facts.text: Each Villa Suite floor plan includes a heated private patio with a Jacuzzi and fire pit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Heated Private Patio with Jacuzzi and Fire Pit

verified_facts.text: Villa Suite interiors feature European white oak floors, hand-tufted rugs and rich leathers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Well appointed with European white oak floors, hand-tufted rugs and rich leathers

verified_facts.text: Villa Suite stays include a personal concierge, a sunrise pastry basket, a s'mores kit and complimentary valet parking.
verified_facts.excerpt: a personal concierge, a sunrise pastry basket, a s’mores kit, and complimentary valet parking

verified_facts.text: The Villa Suites opened as an expansion of the resort in 2021.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 2021, Edgewood Tahoe Resort entered a new era of expansion: The Villa Suites at Edgewood Tahoe.

verified_facts.text: The Edge Restaurant & Lounge has a wine collection of more than 1,000 labels from around the world.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Edge also features an exceptional wine collection of more than 1,000 labels from around the world

verified_facts.text: Brooks' Bar & Deck was created by Shay Zak with influence from architect Frank Gehry.
verified_facts.excerpt: Brought to life by Shay Zak with influence from the renowned architect Frank Gehry

verified_facts.text: The Edge hosts Tea with an Edge, an afternoon tea experience, on Saturdays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Saturday’s \| 1:30 PM – 3:30 PM

verified_facts.text: An event venue expansion is underway from September 2025 to January 2027, with changes to valet parking at the adjacent Clubhouse building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Event Venue Expansion Underway (Sept 2025 – Jan 2027)

verified_facts.text: Resort experiences range from yoga classes to nature walks to crafts and activities.
verified_facts.excerpt: From yoga classes to nature walks to festive crafts and activities, Edgewood has something for everyone

verified_facts.text: The Lodge offers views of Lake Tahoe and the surrounding Sierra Nevada Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: breathtaking views of Lake Tahoe and the surrounding Sierra Nevada Mountains
